patch_description: The current function returns all points at the origin, giving a minimum triangle area of 0. I replace it with a deterministic construction: (1) a hardcoded initial arrangement spread along the boundary and interior of the unit equilateral triangle (inspired by known good Heilbronn-style configurations that distribute points on the edge and interior with an O(1/n^2) smallest-area scale), and (2) a short deterministic greedy local search that repeatedly identifies the smallest-area triangle and perturbs its vertices to enlarge it, clamping points back inside the triangle. This targets the benchmark minimum area of ~0.0365 (score 1.0) while running in milliseconds.
